Name: Beach Farm Redone
Author: pluviophist
Description:
[font=Times New Roman]I love the beach farm, but I wanted a much more open, greener space - so here is my altered map! All grass is tillable and buildable, and sprinklers will work on sand. 

[color=#cc4125]NOTE[/color]: If playing with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url], there is a [color=#9fc5e8]Farm_Island.tmx[/color] file which will overwrite my mod and cause Beach Farm Redone not to show up. A simple fix for now is to replace the [color=#9fc5e8]Farm_Island.tmx[/color] in VPR with the [color=#9fc5e8]Farm_Island.tmx[/color][color=#cfe2f3] [/color]from my mod

[size=4]✿ [/size][size=3][b]Enjoy the map, and please let me know if you come across any issues.[/b][/size][size=4][b] [/b]ʕ •ᴥ•ʔ ♡[/size]

[size=5][size=4]✿[b] Installation[/b][/size][/size]

[/font][list]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.[/font]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Download this mod.[/font]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Unzip the mod into your Stardew Valley "Mods/" folder.[/font]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Run the game using SMAPI.[/font]
[/list][font=Times New Roman]
[b]To uninstall, delete this mod from Mods folder.[/b][/font]
